entities.name: Stockfish at eight strengths
entities.description: The computer opponent plays from beginner to full strength, in the browser.
entities.behavior: Each strength sets Stockfish's Skill Level and a search limit: 0 and depth 1 at strength 1, rising to 18 and one second at 7 and 20 and two seconds at 8. The weakest strengths wait a short moment before answering so they feel like an opponent. A search can be cancelled, and its answer is then dropped.
entities.outcome: A player can play the computer at a strength that suits them without a server or an account.
constraints: One search at a time; a new one or a cancel makes the old answer stale.
Single-threaded lite WebAssembly build: no cross-origin isolation needed, and weaker than full Stockfish at the same settings.
Only in the browser: the desktop build gets no move.

relatedViews.relationship: The use case that exercises it: play the computer.
